description: User cannot recall the account email and offers a username-shaped handle (e.g. mei_kovacs_8020) plus ZIP; the agent refuses to authenticate instead of deriving first/last name from the handle, so the conversation ends with zero tool calls.
proposed_fix: Prompt: when the customer offers a username/user-id-shaped handle, parse first and last name from it and authenticate via find_user_id_by_name_zip with the provided ZIP.

verification.success_criterion: In one subset run: >=5 of the 7 member tasks pass, including >=3 of the 4 deterministic members (5, 8, 9, 67), AND 5/5 controls (12, 24, 60, 76, 111) pass.

description: When proposing an exchange with a price difference, the agent assumes the original payment method instead of asking; the user declines the otherwise-correct proposal.
proposed_fix: Prompt: ask which payment method to use for exchange price differences instead of assuming the original.

verification.success_criterion: Task 52 passes (98 informational; failed only 2/3 baselines).

description: On exchanges the agent echoes the customer's existing item id or picks the wrong sibling variant instead of resolving the requested options to the correct item id via get_product_details.
proposed_fix: Prompt: exchanges must look up the product's variants and select the item id matching the requested options; never reuse the old item id unless the options are identical.

verification.success_criterion: >=3 of 5 members pass, including both deterministic members 91 and 107.

description: When modifying an address the agent rewrites unchanged fields in non-canonical form (country 'United States' vs the DB's 'USA'), failing the DB end-state check.
proposed_fix: Prompt: when modifying addresses, copy unchanged fields verbatim from the existing record.

verification.success_criterion: The wrong_args.modify_pending_order_address.country label is absent for 59 (task-level pass also requires the cancel from multi_request_scope_errors).

description: On multi-part requests the agent drops or over-scopes actions: modifies extra items, performs a return where an exchange was wanted, or misses one of several orders. Heterogeneous; needs per-task reads before a fix is stated.
proposed_fix: TBD after per-task reads; likely running-checklist guidance for multi-part requests.

description: REFUTED as an agent-side cause: task 105's gold action is argument-identical to the agent's rejected call. DB shows paid 2x$94.80, replacements $210.70 (+$21.10), gift card balance $17.00 — the runtime tool forbids the exchange the grader assumes succeeded. Suspected unsolvable task / benchmark defect; document in writeup, no harness fix. Task 71 removed (different shape, unread).
proposed_fix: None — suspected benchmark defect, not agent behavior.

description: When the exact request is unsatisfiable, the agent frames the best alternative around its deviations ('accepting the resolution change?'), and the rigidly-scripted sim declines an option gold expects it to accept (52: primary goal max zoom, price no object; agent led with the drawback all 4 observed attempts).
proposed_fix: Present the closest available option led by the user's primary goal; state deviations factually afterwards; clarify it is the only path to the goal before giving up.

description: In multi-order conversations the agent maps items to the wrong order: 27 placed the return on the order that needed the exchange (the return flipped the status and the gold exchange was then rejected as non-deliverable); 93 exchanged on #W2905754 where gold expects #W4073673.
proposed_fix: Verify item-to-order mapping via get_order_details before writes; treat same-order return+exchange as a mapping error.

description: With multiple option constraints and ranked preferences ('same difficulty, 1000 more pieces, art theme over animals if both available') the agent selects a variant violating the priority order (99, wrong_variant persisted through the basic variant-resolution fix).
proposed_fix: Filter available variants by hard constraints, then apply stated preferences in order; state which preference was applied.

description: One out-of-scope request (refund for a lost tablet) triggered transfer_to_human_agents, ending the conversation before the sim voiced its remaining gold requests (two cancels and a return); 32 made zero writes.
proposed_fix: Decline the unserviceable request and continue serving; transfer only when no serviceable requests remain.
